tests.name: test_list_bookmarks_sort_modified_asc_and_desc
tests.reason: Create three bookmarks with added dates in one order and modified dates in a different order, so neither modified order equals the default added-desc order. Assert GET /api/bookmarks/?sort=modified_asc returns the titles oldest-modified first, and sort=modified_desc the exact reverse. Fails before the change because the unknown value falls back to added-desc.

tests.name: test_list_archived_bookmarks_sort_modified_asc_and_desc
tests.reason: The archived endpoint /api/bookmarks/archived/ is separate from the main list. Use archived bookmarks with modified order differing from added order, plus one non-archived bookmark that must not appear. Assert both sort values on the archived endpoint order the results by date_modified.

tests.name: test_list_bookmarks_unknown_sort_falls_back_to_added_desc
tests.reason: Request ?sort=bogus on fixtures whose added-desc order differs from the modified order. Assert HTTP 200 and added-newest-first order, so the new sort values did not change the fallback. Checked on the archived endpoint as well. This test passes before the change; it guards against regression.

tests.name: test_sort_dropdown_modified_options_reorder_list
tests.reason: One user-visible path: open the bookmark list, open the sort dropdown, assert 'Modified ↑' and 'Modified ↓' are offered, select each one and assert the visible titles reorder by modification date. Fixtures have modified order different from added order. The dropdown is a rendered form control, so only a browser test can verify its labels and that selecting an option reloads the list.

structured.placement_reason: AC1, AC2, AC4 and AC5 concern the REST API sort parameter, which is deterministic and fast to check, so they go in a new API file bookmarks/tests/test_bookmarks_sort_modified_api.py using LinkdingApiTestCase and setup_bookmark with explicit added/modified dates. AC3 is the visible dropdown labels and the reload on selection, so it gets a single browser test in a new bookmarks/tests_e2e/e2e_test_sort_modified.py, in line with the one-or-two-browser-tests-per-feature rule. The archived page dropdown is not tested separately in the browser because it reuses the same form; the archived API is covered at API level. The tests do not touch existing test files and no unit tests are added, since those belong to the implementer.
